title: Introduce SSE chunk acknowledger and mid-JSON detection probe to improve streaming stability
author: Aisha Patel
description: Background: customers observed rare but recurring corrupt JSON payloads when SSE stream fragments split inside complex nested JSON (tool calls / structured output). This manifested as mid-JSON truncation and downstream consumer errors (most commonly with OpenAI-compatible SDKs). Motivation: improve resilience of the stream adapter without changing wire protocol or breaking existing clients. This PR introduces two complementary changes: 1) an SSE chunk acknowledger (lightweight per-connection monotonic ack window) that lets the server detect and heal missing or reordered chunk deliveries during transient backpressure and reconnection; 2) a mid-JSON detection probe that heuristically detects likely-incomplete JSON spans inside SSE chunk boundaries and triggers safe flush/repair semantics for the OpenAI compatibility layer. Key points: - Non-breaking: no client-visible protocol changes. Chunk acknowledger attaches a small opt-in header on server->adapter control frames; adapters that don't understand the header ignore it. - Safety-first: the mid-JSON probe is conservative: it only triggers repair when braces/quotes/commas indicate a high-certainty mid-object cut and when the last N bytes fall on a non-UTF8 boundary or an unbalanced JSON token. - Toolcall ordering: added explicit handoff ordering enforcement between the stream parser and function-call bridge to avoid toolcall interleaving when a mid-JSON resync occurs. Implementation summary: - streaming/sse/acknowledger.go: new component that tracks send sequence and a sliding ack window. Implemented lock-free fast-path and a bounded slow-path to avoid head-of-line blocking. - streaming/sse/parser.rs: extended parser state machine with a MidJsonProbe state; probe scans for unbalanced braces, unterminated strings, and common toolcall sentinel patterns. - openai_compat/stream_adapter.py: integrates the acknowledger control frames and adds a repair handler that emits a safe checkpoint token and attempts to replay small last-N buffers before failing the connection. - streaming/tests/test_mid_json_probe.py and streaming/tests/test_toolcall_ordering.py: broad unit + property tests that exercise corner cases (nested arrays, escaped quotes, multi-byte UTF-8 split across chunks). - docs/compat/streaming.md: documented the heuristics, opt-in header name, and rollout notes for customers running private deployments. Test & validation: - Unit tests: added 28 tests; all pass locally. - Integration: e2e streaming test harness validated recovery across simulated packet drops and reconnections (50k simulated streams). - Load: microbenchmarks show <2% median tail latency impact under typical payload distributions; worst-case repair path triggers extra round-trips as expected. Rollout plan: - Feature gated behind runtime flag 'sse_midjson_probe' default=true for hosted; for private deployments flag off by default and added runtime knob in the console. - Canary on dedicated pools for 72 hours, monitor JSON error rate / fncall ordering regressions, then wide rollout. Backout: runtime flag and adapter simply disabled if a regression appears. Related: addresses customer reports summarized in SUP-504 and ties to ENG-2241 (streaming stability epic).

merge_outcome: squash and merge by Leah Kim; commit message consolidated to: 'sse: add chunk acknowledger and mid-JSON detection probe to harden streaming; add tests and docs'
release_notes: Introduce a conservative mid-JSON detection probe and an SSE chunk acknowledger to reduce occurrences of partial JSON and out-of-order toolcall emissions in streaming responses. No protocol breaking changes. Feature is runtime-gated and can be toggled per deployment.
notes_for_ops: Enable 'sse_midjson_probe' on a small canary pool first. Watch metrics: streaming.json_parse_errors, streaming.toolcall_order_mismatches, streaming.repair_invocations. If repair_invocations spike unexpectedly, toggle off and collect logs (streaming/repair/*.log) for root cause analysis.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: conservative heuristics may under-capture some mid-JSON cases; mitigation: probe is opt-out for private customers and can be tuned. Risk: increased tail latency on repair path; mitigation: repair is limited to small replay window and work is instrumented with detailed metrics.
